rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for doing something directly, including going somewhere without an intermediary or speaking plainly.

example.english: I directly called him, so there was no need to pass it on through someone else.
example.traditional: 我直接打電話畀佢，唔使經人轉告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zik6 zip3 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 keoi5 m4 sai2 ging1 jan4 zyun2 gou3

rows.note: Use this for going straight to a destination without detouring or stopping off.

example.english: I went directly home after work without going for a drink.
example.traditional: 我放工直程返屋企，唔去飲嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 zik6 cing4 faan1 uk1 kei2 m4 heoi3 jam2 je5

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone is speaking frankly or honestly rather than merely stating something plainly.

example.english: Speaking directly, I don't think this plan will work.
example.traditional: 老實講，我覺得呢個計劃唔會成功。
example.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 wui5 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a place that is exactly opposite or directly across from another place.

example.english: The convenience store is directly opposite the bank.
example.traditional: 便利店就喺銀行正對面。
example.jyutping: bin6 lei6 dim3 zau6 hai2 ngan4 hong4 zeng3 deoi3 min6
